title: What Code as Architecture Is
definition: Code as Architecture: walking through code as buildings.
description:
Strip Code as Architecture to its essence and you get walking through code as buildings. Simple to say, civilizational to build.

The path runs through Future Software Paradigms: first code cities understanding, then architecture logistics prototypes, then layout algorithms operations at scale. Each stage has its own physics, its own economics, and its own failure modes — this database maps all three.

Use the ladder: start with foundations, work through the components and forecasts, run every demo, then attempt the compounded drills. By the final record you will hold a working mental model of architecture hulls, grounded in real research and honest about what remains unknown.

t: Real Research Today: Code as Architecture
title: Real Research Today: Code as Architecture
definition: Today's documented research behind Code as Architecture.
description:
The road to Code as Architecture is already being paved. The Lean theorem prover and Coq/Isabelle communities verify real software mathematically. Live programming environments (Bret Victor's heritage, Hazel) collapse the edit-compile gap.

WebAssembly brings sandboxed near-native code to every browser and edge device. Together these programs form the code cities foundation that Code as Architecture will build on — the architecture logistics results, the layout algorithms methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as architecture logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Code as Architecture
definition: Estimates Code as Architecture readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Code as Architecture components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a architecture hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Code as Architecture Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Code as Architecture operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Code as Architecture installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 44211 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where code cities monitoring, architecture logistics redundancy, or layout algorithms maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Code as Architecture Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Code as Architecture: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Code as Architecture — walking through code as buildings.

Phase 1 — Prove (code cities): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (architecture logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (layout algorithms): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (VR navigation): architecture hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and developers-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
